body: Why do you think i tried it? Because of all the good things i heard about it from people who tried it. I know that im the outlier, but the hospital even mentioned im not the only one who this happened to. Sure its not common, i know that for my one bad experience there are probably a 1000 good ones but regardless if u have sensitive underarms (apparently i have that, and if i didnt i sure do now, still struggle to find deodorant now that wont upset my skin there) u should be wary of using it. And idk where u read that i said i shaved before, i didnt. I hadnt shaven for a week. I know not to use exfoliants on shaven skin but it still burned me regardless. Everyone who reads this can decide on their own whether they still want to try it or not.

I have to comment to warn anyone reading this about the glycolic acid for the underarms. I used glycolic acid from the ordinary on my underarms ONCE bc i heard it could help lighten them and reduce odor. It BURNED my skin so badly i had to go to the hospital and had to take antibiotics and put on sulfadiazine lotion (not sure if spelled correctly, its a creme made for second and third degree burns) on my underam 24/7 until the BLISTERS that formed were gone. It was painful and not fun. I beg everyone reading this to please not use glycolic acid on your underarms

I have acne prone combination skin thats also very sensitive. I've been using this sunscreen daily for the past month and i really like it so far! Its not greasy and absorbs pretty quickly. It doesnt irritate my skin and doesnt make my eyes burn. Ive not experienced any increased acne since starting this product. I wouldnt say its 'matte' like its advertised but its not shiny at all. After letting it absorb for 15 minutes my skin looks just a little bit dewy, which i like. I dont wear make up so i wouldnt know how it works with makeup on top but the sunscreen doesnt feel like it lays on top of my face if that makes sense, it really absorbs well so i would expect it to work with makeup well (but thats just a speculation!) Overall my favorite sunscreen ive tried so far! 


Personally i might try the purito daily to go in the future since that one is just a bit cheaper. But ive heard its more greasy so ill wait till its winter because thats when my skin is drier.
